title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Festival Hall, Melbourne | 2013
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Festival Hall in Melbourne, Australia, on 16 February 2013.

It was the sixth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s 2013 tour, which lasted for 28 dates between February and November, and the first of two consecutive nights in Melbourne.

The Beatles had performed at Festival Hall on 15, 16, and 17 June 1964.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
